snippet.title: ASTHENIA- Pre-Demo Short Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Hey everyone!
This is a short teaser of ASTHENIA demo, which will be available to play for the first time in Greece game event :
https://joistpark.eu/ekdiloseis/game-developers-meetup-3/

I will be working on the Steam demo launch as well after that! :)

Wishlist ASTHENIA on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3181660/ASTHENIA/
